newsitem.title: USA: OrthoLogic sees Q3 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: OrthoLogic sees Q3 results below estimates.

text.p: OrthoLogic Corp said Tuesday after the market closed that it anticipates posting third quarter net income of $0.02 to $0.04 a share, below analysts' projections.
OrthoLogic said it expects to show third quarter revenue of $10.4 to $10.8 million.
According to First Call, the consensus analyst estimate for OrthoLogic's third quarter earnings is $0.08 a share.
The previous third quarter, the company reported a net loss of $0.01 cent a share on revenue of $4.1 million.

The company said it attributes the quarter's results to a slower than anticipated increase in sales resulting from its recent conversion to a direct sales force from an independent dealer network, and to the costs associated with this transition.
OrthoLogic develops, manufactures and markets orthopaedic devices designed to promote the healing of musculoskeletal tissue.
